name: @chethandvg/pitch-math
description: Equal temperament, cents and octave folding, with a Lean 4 proof that every frequency folds into exactly one octave.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pitch_math_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pitch_math_wasm.wasm
